description: List the ready-made recipes (signed Shortcuts) the user can install from the Askew app, with what each does, its input/output contract, iPad limits and whether it is already installed on this account (installed=yes/no/OUTDATED). Use it when no installed route fits the task, to tell the user which recipe to add; askew_list_routes only shows what is already installed. Works without a connector key (install state is then unknown).

query.description: Optional word to filter by (route id, name, description or app), e.g. 'photo', 'contacts', 'health'. Omit to list every recipe.

name: askew_recipes_catalog
